items.title: How Lossless Is Lossless Speculative Decoding? The Role of Numerical Precision in Orthrus
items.summary: Orthrus achieves lossless speculative decoding only under high numerical precision, with trajectory divergence under BF16 that does not impair downstream benchmarks.

items.title: ModaLens: Measuring Image Sensitivity in Report-Conditioned Medical VLMs
items.summary: A paired image-swap audit reveals that report availability substantially reduces vision-language model sensitivity to image changes in radiology question answering.

items.title: Dynin-Robotics: Omnimodal Unified Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model
items.summary: A shared trajectory model unifies goal and dynamics prediction with action generation for language-conditioned robot control, improving adaptation and success through joint denoising and test-time scaling.

items.title: LynnReal-Omni: Native multi-modal Video Generation for Agentic Visual Workflows
items.summary: LynnReal-Omni is a unified multimodal video diffusion framework that integrates agentic visual controls with high-fidelity generation and real-time acceleration.

items.title: Expert-Space Exploration in MoE Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: ESRL improves reinforcement learning for mixture-of-experts language models by exploring expert routing with anchored high-confidence experts, entropy-adaptive perturbation, and path replay to boost rollout diversity and training performance.

items.title: MInTRL: Off-policy Intervention can boost On-policy RL
items.summary: Minimal Intervention Reinforcement Learning improves on-policy exploration by applying sparse local corrections during rollouts and training with a sequence-level advantage-regression objective.

items.title: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
items.summary: Grouped Value Attention reduces transformer KV cache size by storing grouped values and reconstructing keys via a learned linear map, achieving near-GQA accuracy with a smaller persistent cache.

items.title: Building a Production Greek-English Speech Recognizer
items.summary: A production bilingual Greek-English speech recognition system was engineered through iterative training, data filtering, ablation studies, and model ensembling to meet strict quality gates and achieve competitive benchmark results.

items.title: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video
items.summary: AlayaVista decouples panoramic scene evolution from perspective video synthesis to enable efficient, high-fidelity interactive world modeling, supported by the MUGEN dataset.

items.title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
items.summary: RSIAgent is a training-free multi-agent framework that enables recursive self-improvement via autonomous memory construction and broad-then-deep exploration to adapt digital agents to new environments.

items.title: HazardAuditor: From Executable Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: HazardAuditor provides execution-grounded safety supervision for computer-use agents and introduces Guard Policy Optimization to align generative guard training with sequence-level safety outcomes.

items.title: Agent as Policy for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: A general-purpose agent directly controls a physical robot by interpreting visuals, writing executable programs, and revising actions based on physical feedback across diverse manipulation tasks.

items.title: Pick Your Poison: Learning to Select Poison Sets for Stronger LLM Backdoor Attacks
items.summary: Backdoor vulnerability in fine-tuned language models varies drastically with poison selection, and a learned set-scoring method improves worst-case attack success by identifying high-impact poisoned examples.

items.title: Enabling Creative Exploration for Vibe Design Agents
items.summary: Separating design exploration from code generation via structured intermediate specifications enables diverse UI alternatives without altering downstream generation settings.

items.title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents' Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
items.summary: Elo-per-token analysis reveals that LLM agents initially scale faster than independent sampling but eventually slow, while parallel short sessions improve performance over single long runs.

items.title: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
items.summary: Atria Dawn Preview is a foundation agentic language model trained through verified tool interactions that achieves strong benchmark results and demonstrates a shift toward human-AI project-level collaboration in scientific research.

items.title: Kaininja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
items.summary: KaiNinja extends a native 3D generator to part-level outputs using a dual-volume representation that resolves interface conflicts, improving both part and whole-object fidelity without segmentation.

items.title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
items.summary: ZGCM-1 is a 7B open foundation model that combines internal reasoning with external tool use, trained via efficient architecture-system co-design, progressive long-context scaling, and autonomous agent workflows to achieve strong reasoning and efficiency.

items.title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
items.summary: PhysBrain 1.5 unifies physical environment understanding, action generation, and future state prediction via joint autoregressive training on discrete vision-language, motion, and visual target sequences, achieving state-of-the-art open-source embodied performance.

items.title: Not All Prompts Are Equal: Exploration-Guided Prompt Scaffolding for Multimodal Reinforcement Post-Training
items.summary: The framework dynamically adjusts training prompts via exploration potential scoring and scaffolded rewrites to improve reinforcement learning for multimodal language models.

items.title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
items.summary: Vidu S2 introduces real-time interactive avatar and video editing models that support high-resolution spatial video generation and dynamic reference updates.

items.title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
items.summary: Discovery Foundation Models enable open-ended scientific discovery through iterative problem formulation, hypothesis testing, and evidence-based revision across dry and wet lab settings.

items.title: Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning
items.summary: Attention-DP3 improves 3D diffusion policies by injecting object-level geometric cues via attention to stabilize performance under heavy clutter.

items.title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
items.summary: A benchmark requiring agents to programmatically reconstruct real-world videos in Blender reveals that current models achieve high perceptual similarity but struggle to retain spatiotemporal facts.

items.title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
items.summary: A 16.7B-parameter mixture-of-experts diffusion vision-language agent achieves strong multimodal GUI performance while preserving block-parallel decoding efficiency.

items.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
items.summary: Dream-RSI enables scalable recursive self-improvement by using historical discovery replay to evaluate exploration policies offline, reducing costly online evaluations.

items.title: Omni-Streaming Thinking
items.summary: Omni-Streaming Thinking improves streaming omni-modal reasoning by deferring claims until cross-modal verification, reducing premature commitment and auditory hallucinations.

items.title: ReMoMask-2: Latent Retrieval-Augmented Masked Motion Generation
items.summary: ReMoMask improves text-to-motion generation via hierarchical contrastive retrieval and topology-aware fusion, while ReMoMask-2 eliminates representation gaps by embedding retrieval directly into the generator's latent space.

items.title: MobileVLA-R1 2.0: RL-Enhanced Reasoning for Mobile Robot Control
items.summary: MobileVLA-R1 2.0 couples structured reasoning with robot control via chain-of-thought alignment and reinforcement learning to improve long-horizon mobile robot instruction following.

items.title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
items.summary: Occamy-1.0 is a cost-efficient co-work agent model that achieves strong performance on complex multi-step tasks while maintaining broad agentic capabilities at lower cost.

items.title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
items.summary: Pelican-Sim 1.0 is a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions, using unified action representations, action-visual injection, sparse mixture-of-experts, and efficient rollout generation to improve controllability and video quality across diverse embodiments and tasks.

items.title: ReactHuman: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Human-Like Reactive Decision-Making in Embodied Multimodal LLMs
items.summary: ReactHuman is a physics-grounded benchmark that evaluates multimodal large language models as decision cores for simulated humanoid robots facing sudden household hazards, revealing persistent reactive safety failures.

items.title: Competence-Gated Pooling of Language Models and Priors for Event Forecasting
items.summary: A competence gate selectively integrates language model forecasts by estimating domain-level marginal value over external predictions, improving hybrid forecasting accuracy.

items.title: Feature Recovery for Object Understanding After Irreversible Fire Damage
items.summary: TRACE is a benchmark for post-fire object understanding that introduces a feature recovery module to restore degraded representations and improve detection and vision-language tasks under severe physical damage.

items.title: Towards a Deterministic Math Solver for Clinical Language Models
items.summary: A program-solve interface that delegates arithmetic to a restricted Python executor improves clinical calculator accuracy for larger open-weight language models but not consistently for smaller ones, and it does not replace verified formulas or reliable variable extraction.

items.title: Ambient @ EgoProactive 2026 : Proactive Egocentric Assistance with Visually Grounded Supervision
items.summary: The approach reformulates intervention timing as single-token classification and uses a video agent for visual supervision to improve wearable assistant decision-making.

items.title: Ambient @ EgoLongQA 2026: Distilling Long-Video perception into a Sub-2B Model
items.summary: A 2B vision-language model distilled from a tool-using agent achieves first-place performance on long egocentric video question answering by pruning its multilingual embedding table to meet parameter limits.

items.title: Studying Without a Syllabus: Task-Agnostic Environment Preprocessing
items.summary: An agent can explore unfamiliar environments without task-specific guidance to build reusable artifacts that reduce later inference costs, though larger study budgets do not always improve results.

items.title: TRACE: Trajectory-robust Admission with Evidence Ordering for Efficient GUI Agents
items.summary: TRACE is a training-free framework that ranks visual evidence by future utility and diversity, reserves native tokens for spatial coverage, and contracts retired frames to reduce latency and memory in GUI agents.

items.title: ActionSplice: In-Flight Action Editing for Interactive World Models
items.summary: ActionSplice introduces counterfactual state transport to splice revised actions into chunk-autoregressive video world models without replaying completed evaluations, improving fidelity and speed.

items.title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
items.summary: DataFlex-RL evaluates reinforcement learning data policies and finds that uniform sampling matches or exceeds adaptive rollout selection, reweighting, and domain mixing across math, logic, and science benchmarks.

items.title: Building and Evaluating Fixed-Voice Thai TTS from Synthetic Speech
items.summary: A compact Thai text-to-speech model is distilled from a large voice-cloning teacher using synthetic data from brief voice references, achieving strong on-device accuracy and prosody with minimal errors.

items.title: How Far Can Synthetic Data Take Thai OCR?
items.summary: A Thai OCR model trained solely on synthetic documents achieves strong real-world performance by isolating key transfer factors like typography, layout, and handwriting glyphs.

items.title: Beyond Top-k Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents
items.summary: Diverse Skill Routing improves LLM agent skill selection by balancing relevance with non-redundancy via a determinantal point process, boosting multi-skill coverage.

items.title: Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback
items.summary: Adaptive routing of prompts to LLM experts is formulated as a contextual bandit problem with limited feedback, yielding algorithms with sublinear regret bounds and effective routing strategies.

items.title: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report
items.summary: StepAudio 3 Gen is a discrete autoregressive audio generation model that uses residual vector quantization tokens and a shared code space to unify text-to-speech, voice design, sound effects, and music within a single framework.

items.title: Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models
items.summary: A data-centric framework with specialized systems for reasoning analysis, cost reduction, and execution verification enables small teams to train open-weight cyber agents that achieve top-tier performance on benchmark suites.

items.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
items.summary: Benchmark Radar is a searchable living database and discovery engine for AI evaluation benchmarks that aggregates sources, score histories, and evidence to support benchmark selection and comparison.

items.title: Breaking the Vision-Action Shortcut: Latent Interface Training for Generalizable Robotics Foundation Models
items.summary: LIT improves robot action generalization by first training pose-conditioned action priors without images, then constraining visual inputs through a pose-supervised latent interface that preserves spatial goal information.

items.title: COBRA-Skills: Contextual Bandit-Guided Evolution for Agent Skill Optimization
items.summary: COBRA-Skills improves LLM agent skill optimization by using contextual-bandit prioritization and evidence-based evolution to cut evaluation costs while maintaining high performance.
